item.title: Youth report: Stags U18 4-0 Notts County U18
item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s cruised to a 4-0 derby day victory over local rivals Notts County on Saturday, as the young Stags retained the Matt Salmon Trophy at RH Academy.Forward Zidan Ali put the amber and blue in front after five minutes with his second goal for the under-18s. Three further goals in a six-minute blitz courtesy of winger Jayden Chambers-Morgan, striker Joe Grant and another from Ali put the game to bed after just 23 minutes.Professional development phase lead coach Steve Chettle
